name: add_attachment
description: Attaches local files (filePath, or several with filePaths), or the given text as a file, to an issue or a knowledge base article. Article text can then reference the images by file name. Returns the attachment IDs.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 (or pass articleId)

arguments.name: articleId
arguments.desc: Knowledge base article ID, e.g. DEMO-A-4 (instead of issueId)

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.desc: Local file to attach

arguments.name: filePaths
arguments.desc: Several local files to attach in one request, e.g. all images of an article

arguments.name: fileName
arguments.desc: Name for a single attachment; required with textContent, defaults to the file's name

arguments.name: textContent
arguments.desc: Attach this text instead of a local file, e.g. a log excerpt

name: add_issue_comment
description: Adds a comment to an issue, optionally visible only to given users and groups. Markdown is supported. Returns the comment ID and URL.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Comment text, Markdown supported

arguments.name: permittedUsers
arguments.desc: Limit visibility to these user logins

arguments.name: permittedGroups
arguments.desc: Limit visibility to these group names

name: add_issue_to_sprint
description: Adds an issue to a sprint (the current one by default) of an agile board.

arguments.name: board
arguments.desc: Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13

arguments.name: sprint
arguments.desc: Sprint name or ID, or current. Default: current.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123

name: apply_command
description: Applies a YouTrack command to one or more issues, the same as the command dialog in the UI: set fields, assign, tag, move to another project, add links, vote, star and more in one line. The command is validated first and nothing is applied if any part is invalid; dryRun only validates and lists suggestions.

arguments.name: command
arguments.desc: Command as typed in the YouTrack command dialog, e.g. State In Progress, for jdoe, tag backend, Priority Critical, project OPS, remove tag backend

arguments.name: issueIds
arguments.desc: Issues to apply the command to, e.g. ["DEMO-1","DEMO-2"]

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Apply to all issues matching this search query instead (at most 100)

arguments.name: comment
arguments.desc: Comment to add together with the command

arguments.name: silent
arguments.desc: Don't send notifications about the change. Default false.

arguments.name: dryRun
arguments.desc: Only parse the command and report what it would do or why it is invalid. Default false.

name: call_api
description: Calls any YouTrack (or Hub) REST endpoint as the current user, for what no other tool covers. YouTrack returns only entity IDs unless you pass a fields query, e.g. fields=idReadable,summary,customFields(name,value(name)). Prefer GET; POST and DELETE change data. Reference: https://www.jetbrains.com/help/youtrack/devportal/api-entities.html

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: HTTP method

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path relative to the API root, e.g. issues/DEMO-1/comments or admin/projects; a query string may be included

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Query parameters, e.g. {"fields":"idReadable,summary","$top":10}; arrays repeat the parameter

arguments.name: body
arguments.desc: JSON request body for POST

arguments.name: api
arguments.desc: youtrack (/api/…, default) or hub (/hub/api/rest/…)

name: change_issue_assignee
description: Sets the Assignee of an issue. Pass null to unassign.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123

arguments.name: assigneeLogin
arguments.desc: Login of the new assignee, or null to unassign

name: count_issues
description: Counts issues matching a YouTrack search query without fetching them.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: YouTrack search query, same syntax as search_issues

name: create_article
description: Creates a knowledge base article, optionally under a parent article and with limited visibility. Returns the article ID and URL.

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Project key, e.g. HELP

arguments.name: summary
arguments.desc: Article title

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: Article content in Markdown

arguments.name: parentArticle
arguments.desc: ID of the parent article, e.g. HELP-A-1

arguments.name: permittedUsers
arguments.desc: Limit visibility to these user logins

arguments.name: permittedGroups
arguments.desc: Limit visibility to these group names

name: create_draft_issue
description: Creates an issue draft visible only to the current user. Fill it in with update_issue using the returned draft ID. Returns the draft ID (e.g. 3-22) and URL.

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Project key, e.g. DEMO

arguments.name: summary
arguments.desc: Draft summary

name: create_issue
description: Creates an issue. Call get_issue_fields_schema first: projects may require fields on creation. If the project is not known, ask the user. Returns the issue ID and URL.

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Project key, e.g. DEMO. Ask the user if unknown.

arguments.name: summary
arguments.desc: Issue summary (title)

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: Issue description, plain text or Markdown

arguments.name: customFields
arguments.desc: Custom field values keyed by exact field name from get_issue_fields_schema, e.g. {"Type":"Task","Priority":"Minor"}. Multi-value fields take arrays.

arguments.name: parentIssue
arguments.desc: ID of the parent issue; the new issue becomes its subtask

arguments.name: permittedUsers
arguments.desc: Limit visibility to these user logins

arguments.name: permittedGroups
arguments.desc: Limit visibility to these group names

name: create_saved_search
description: Saves a search query under a name. It is not added to favorites; pin it in the UI to see it in get_saved_issue_searches.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Saved search name

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: YouTrack search query

name: create_sprint
description: Creates a sprint on an agile board that uses sprints. Returns the sprint with its ID and URL.

arguments.name: board
arguments.desc: Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13

arguments.name: goal
arguments.desc: Sprint goal

arguments.name: start
arguments.desc: First day, yyyy-MM-dd

arguments.name: finish
arguments.desc: Last day, yyyy-MM-dd

name: create_tag
description: Creates a tag owned by the current user. Use manage_issue_tags to put it on issues.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Tag name

name: delete_article
description: Permanently deletes a knowledge base article. If it has sub-articles, delete or move them first (get_article lists them).

arguments.name: articleId
arguments.desc: Article ID, e.g. HELP-A-1

name: delete_attachment
description: Permanently deletes an attachment from an issue or article.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 (or pass articleId)

arguments.name: articleId
arguments.desc: Knowledge base article ID, e.g. DEMO-A-4 (instead of issueId)

arguments.name: attachment
arguments.desc: Attachment ID (e.g. 12-169) or file name

name: delete_issue
description: Permanently deletes an issue or a draft, with its comments, attachments and work items. This cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123, or draft ID, e.g. 3-22

name: delete_issue_comment
description: Deletes a comment from an issue. By default it is marked deleted, as in the UI, and can be restored there; permanent erases it. Comment IDs come from get_issue_comments.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123

arguments.name: commentId
arguments.desc: Comment ID as returned by get_issue_comments, e.g. 4-17

arguments.name: permanent
arguments.desc: Erase the comment for good instead of marking it deleted (needs the Delete Comment permission). Default false.

name: delete_saved_search
description: Permanently deletes a saved search.

arguments.name: search
arguments.desc: Saved search ID or name; among equal names your own search wins

name: delete_sprint
description: Permanently deletes a sprint from an agile board. Its issues are kept but leave the sprint. To keep history, archive it with update_sprint instead.

arguments.name: board
arguments.desc: Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13

arguments.name: sprint
arguments.desc: Sprint name or ID

name: delete_tag
description: Permanently deletes a tag and removes it from all issues.

arguments.name: tag
arguments.desc: Tag ID or name; among equal names your own tag wins

name: delete_work_item
description: Permanently deletes a spent time work item. Work item IDs come from get_issue_work_items.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123

arguments.name: workItemId
arguments.desc: Work item ID from get_issue_work_items or log_work, e.g. 199-6

name: edit_article_content
description: Changes part of an article's content by exact find-and-replace, without resending the whole text. Read the article first and copy oldText from it, or set regexp to match a pattern. All edits apply or none do. Returns the article ID, URL and number of replacements.

arguments.name: articleId
arguments.desc: Article ID, e.g. HELP-A-1

arguments.name: edits
arguments.desc: Replacements applied in order, each to the result of the previous one

name: edit_issue_description
description: Changes part of an issue's description by exact find-and-replace, without resending the whole text. Read the issue first and copy oldText from it, or set regexp to match a pattern. All edits apply or none do. Returns the issue ID, URL and number of replacements.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123, or draft ID, e.g. 3-22

arguments.name: edits
arguments.desc: Replacements applied in order, each to the result of the previous one

name: find_agile_boards
description: Finds agile boards whose name or project key contains a substring (case-insensitive). Returns ID, name, projects, whether sprints are used and the current sprint.

arguments.name: nameContains
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive substring of the board name or project key; empty string lists all boards

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Number of boards to skip. Default 0.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max boards to return. Default 20, max 20.

name: find_projects
description: Finds projects whose name or key contains a substring (case-insensitive). Returns key, name and ID. Paginated.

arguments.name: nameContains
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive substring of the project name or key; empty string lists all projects

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Number of projects to skip. Default 0.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max projects to return. Default 20, max 20.

name: find_tags
description: Finds tags visible to the current user by name substring. Returns ID, name and owner.

arguments.name: nameContains
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive substring of the tag name; empty string lists all visible tags

name: find_user
description: Finds a user by login or email. Returns login, full name, email and time zone.

arguments.name: loginOrEmail
arguments.desc: Login or email of the user; "me" returns the current user

name: find_user_groups
description: Finds user groups and project teams whose name contains a substring (case-insensitive). Paginated.

arguments.name: nameContains
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive substring of the group name; empty string lists all groups

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Number of groups to skip. Default 0.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max groups to return. Default 20, max 20.

name: get_agile_board
description: Returns an agile board: projects, owner, columns and the field they map to, estimation field, sprint settings, the current sprint and recent sprints.

arguments.name: board
arguments.desc: Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13

arguments.name: includeArchived
arguments.desc: Also list archived sprints. Default false.

arguments.name: sprintsLimit
arguments.desc: Max sprints to list, newest first. Default 20.

name: get_article
description: Returns an article: title, content, parent and sub-articles, tags, attachments and visibility. Long content can be read in segments with linesOffset and linesCount.

arguments.name: articleId
arguments.desc: Article ID, e.g. HELP-A-1

arguments.name: linesOffset
arguments.desc: First content line to return, 0-based. Default 0.

arguments.name: linesCount
arguments.desc: Number of content lines to return. Default 500.

name: get_attachment
description: Reads an attachment of an issue or article. Text files are returned as text and images as images; other files, or anything too large to inline, are saved to saveTo on this machine.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 (or pass articleId)

arguments.name: articleId
arguments.desc: Knowledge base article ID, e.g. DEMO-A-4 (instead of issueId)

arguments.name: attachment
arguments.desc: Attachment ID (e.g. 12-169) or file name

arguments.name: saveTo
arguments.desc: Local file or directory to save the attachment to instead of returning it

name: get_current_user
description: Returns login, email, full name and time zone of the current user.

name: get_issue
description: Returns full details of an issue: summary, description, URL, project, reporter, tags, votes, custom fields, links, attachments and the most recent comments.

arguments.name: issueId
arguments.desc: Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123, or draft ID, e.g. 3-22

arguments.name: recentCommentsCount
arguments.desc: How many latest comments to include. Default 5.

name: get_issue_activities
description: Returns the change history of an issue: who changed which field, comments, links, tags, attachments, sprints and work items, with old and new values. Newest first by default; paginated with a cursor.

arguments.name: categories

arguments.name: limit

arguments.name: issueId

name: restore_issue_comment

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Knowledge base query, e.g. project: HELP, author: me, tag: faq, created: {This month}, "exact phrase", free text

arguments.name: offset

name: search_issues
description:
Searches issues with the YouTrack query language and returns id, summary, project, resolved, reporter, created, updated and the requested custom fields. Use get_issue for full details. Paginated.

YouTrack search query. Syntax:
- free text matches summary, description and comments; wildcards * and ?
- attribute filters: project: DEMO, for: me, reporter: jdoe, tag: {multi word}, <Field>: <Value> (e.g. State: Open, Priority: Critical)
- negation with -: State: -Fixed; multi-word names and values in braces: {Fix versions}: {2026.1 EAP}
- dates: created: {This month}, updated: {minus 2h} .. *, created: 2026-01-01 .. 2026-02-01
- shortcuts: #Unresolved, #Resolved, has: attachments, has: -comments
- links: <link type>: DEMO-1 (e.g. subtask of: DEMO-1), links: DEMO-1, mentions: DEMO-1
- terms are joined with AND by space; use "or" and parentheses for alternatives
- sort: sort by: updated desc

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: YouTrack search query, see the tool description for syntax

arguments.name: customFieldsToReturn
arguments.desc: Custom fields to include in results. Default: Type, State, Assignee. Pass [] for none.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Number of issues to skip. Default 0.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max issues to return. Default 20, max 20.

name: unlink_issues
description: Removes a link between two issues; arguments mirror link_issues. {"targetIssueId":"DEMO-1","linkType":"subtask of","issueToLinkId":"DEMO-2"} makes DEMO-1 no longer a subtask of DEMO-2.

arguments.name: targetIssueId
arguments.desc: Issue that gets the link, e.g. DEMO-1

arguments.name: linkType
arguments.desc: Link name as read from the target issue, e.g. relates to, subtask of, parent for, depends on, is required for, duplicates, is duplicated by

arguments.name: issueToLinkId
arguments.desc: Issue to link to, e.g. DEMO-2
